dev_environment: Development PC (Xeon + GTX 1070) without YuE2 or Seed-VC: stand-in runtime with FFmpeg 8.1.1, Python 3.11, numpy/scipy/soundfile/librosa and placeholder YuE2 files; a stand-in Seed-VC inference.py with the pinned interface runs under the real seedvc_runner.py.

speed_versions.method: Derived key/tempo job on the finished version (audio_adjust independent mode: Rubber Band when the local FFmpeg has it, else asetrate + atempo); no reverb; no regeneration.
speed_versions.queued_by: service.finish_attempt after a generated version completes, once per version, when the job's speed_variants flag is on.

speed_variant_checks: Presets are exact named independent adjustments; a name that does not match its preset is refused; plain adjustments never gain a name; label returns the preset name.

Shared switch defaults on, persists off/on over HTTP, refuses non-booleans, and an unusable stored value falls back to on; batch items carry speed_variants into config and job, invalid values reject the batch.
Per-song override: null follows the shared switch, true/false persist and show in the track list, non-boolean values are refused, an unusable stored value follows the shared switch.

A completed generated version queues exactly Speed Up, Slowed and Super Slowed (worker order), auto, same group and letter, parent WAV as source, preset durations, names with Original Voice kept; finishing again never duplicates.
Nothing is queued for a switched-off version, a failed attempt, or a derived (adjust) work.
Queueing problems are recorded in speed_variant_errors on the parent and never break the worker.
Real FFmpeg render of Speed Up: output 1/1.12 of the length, one semitone higher, named (Speed Up).wav/.mp3, derived notice, parent WAV untouched.
browser_verified: Shared settings show the new panel with the three presets and the switch on by default
Switching off updates the heading, the footer count and the saved setting; switching on restores them
Footer shows the versions plus 3x speed versions; the confirmation dialog shows N full versions + 3N speed versions
Per-song "加速与慢速版本" select: switching one song to original speed only lowers the footer and dialog counts and survives a reload
My Works shows the three auto speed versions under the same song with badges Speed Up / Slowed / Super Slowed and the version letter, names keep Original Voice

validation_limitations: No real YuE2, UVR or Seed-VC inference was possible on the development PC; the speed versions were rendered from stand-in and synthetic audio only.
Listening quality of the independent tempo/pitch change at 1.12x / 0.85x / 0.75x on real songs is not verified; Rubber Band availability on the app PC's FFmpeg decides the method.
Processing time of the three derived versions on the app PC is not measured; it is CPU-only and runs in the effects queue beside generation.
